source: local repoe PoE2 data rip with selfpoe-validated breach_desecration rows
notes: Normal item prefix/suffix families are tiered by required level descending: highest unlocked family member is T1.
Desecrated-domain gear mods are included as single T1 rules for Well of Souls special choices.
Map, radius-jewel, unsupported unique-only, charm, and flask records are excluded from the normal Well dataset.
Each tier stores every visible numeric component in values[], so damage ranges and hybrid affixes can be matched as a whole.
Applicability is resolved from spawn tags first, then reviewed key/type fallback where needed.
Non-desecrated one-tier numeric superset families are excluded when a same-class same-text multi-tier ladder exists.
Rules are filtered by item level at runtime; T1 is best.
Breach/Otherworldly GenesisTree accessory rules are validated against selfpoe_data breach_desecration rows before insertion.
Raw selfpoe_data is not used as a full replacement source because broad validation can reveal display-normalization mismatches.
